marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 Wednesday
morning. Snow beginning this evening with a risk of freezing rain
changing to scattered flurries Wednesday morning. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures plus 1 falling to minus 5 Wednesday
evening. Freezing spray beginning Wednesday afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 near
midnight.<br/>
